owner_creation.analysis: table_rows: This c_int owns the last initialized geometry, distinct from capacity; pos_init starts at zero and updates it after clearing changed rows.
owner_creation.invariant: Logical row count tracks initialized table content.
limitations: Source-level growth/fatal-cleanup ordering concern is recorded under existing M0-MEM-001; no new runtime proof or fix is claimed. M0-MEM-003 and IND-POS-F4 remain open.

aliases_escapes.analysis: table_rows: Readers copy min(sc_height,table_rows) before scanning; no array reference is returned by the row-count value.
aliases_escapes.invariant: Logical rows limit a scan but do not own its bytes.
limitations: Source-level growth/fatal-cleanup ordering concern is recorded under existing M0-MEM-001; no new runtime proof or fix is claimed. M0-MEM-003 and IND-POS-F4 remain open.

callback_targets.analysis: table_rows: No callback target lives in this field; get_scrpos consumes it during ordinary navigation and fatal cleanup through direct calls.

invalidation.analysis: table_rows: Resize reuse invalidates removed/newly exposed rows before changing the count; old rows may nevertheless describe a freed array during allocation growth.

mutation_commit.analysis: table_rows: On success table_rows is assigned after table and capacity; on reuse it is assigned after the invalidation loop. Growth failure prevents that joint update.
mutation_commit.invariant: Row publication must remain coherent with its backing owner.
limitations: Source-level growth/fatal-cleanup ordering concern is recorded under existing M0-MEM-001; no new runtime proof or fix is claimed. M0-MEM-003 and IND-POS-F4 remain open.

release_pair.analysis: table_rows: The scalar has no destructor/free pair; clearing rows logically retires positions without releasing array capacity.
